description: Search for places (cities, towns, landmarks, regions) by name and get which STATE / PROVINCE / COUNTY / PREFECTURE / administrative division (German Bundesland, UK county, Canadian province, Japanese prefecture, Indian/Australian/Mexican state, etc.) they are in, plus country, coordinates, population, and feature type. Answers "what state is <city> in", "which US/German/Australian state is <city> in", "what province/county/prefecture/region is <place> in" — the `admin_region` field is the state/province/county/prefecture (e.g. search_geonames("Naperville", "US") → Illinois; ("Heidelberg", "DE") → Baden-Württemberg; ("Leeds", "GB") → England; ("Osaka", "JP") → Osaka). Worldwide coverage. Example: search_geonames("Paris", "FR"). Use get_nearby to find places near a known location.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to filter (e.g., "US", "JP")

query.description: Place name to search for (e.g., "Tokyo", "Grand Canyon")

name: search_geonames
